decision: All candidates rejected; production and production components were never edited by this experiment.
scope: Small-alphabet Oct rank and one-level count exploration before the final sum-focused/hash integration.

conditions.timed: Queries only; input generation, construction and I/O excluded.
conditions.bounds: Component benchmark uses the main benchmark min(x,y) convention; interval benchmark uses uniform x and swaps only for between queries.

candidates.small_exact: An extra bool fits existing padding (sizeof OctBitVector remains 32). When all digits are below 4, cumulative lanes 0..3 are kept and unused lanes 4..7 become exact digit counts/masks. AVX route/select uses active-mask 15 or 255. Scalar/AVX2 builds set and reset the flag.
candidates.binary_rank: An extra bool fits padding. For at most two digits, rank uses below(r,1) for digit0 and its complement for digit1. Cumulative lanes and route/select remain unchanged.
candidates.interval_one: Only WaveletMatrix interval_scalar/interval_avx2 change. Single-level matrices take a direct rank path; two distinct values use below(l/r,1) and its complement. The component is unchanged.

findings: small_exact improves one sigma256 count case (3.620 to 3.198 ms) but regresses sigma256 kth (4.887 to 5.473 ms), sigma512 kth, and broad-range freq (n500k: 32.828 to 36.775 ms). It does not consistently improve sigma2 count.
binary_rank does not improve sigma2 count consistently and adds regressions to other distributions.

interval_one changes sigma2 count q500k from 4.163 to 4.166 ms at n200k, and 4.640 to 4.562 ms at n500k. Old quad is 3.919 and 4.102 ms in the same runs. This is insufficient evidence to adopt more code.

A likely limitation is rank working-set size: Oct stores 64 bytes per 32 input elements, while old Quad stores 32 bytes per 64. At sigma2 both have one level, so the Oct rank working set is four times larger. This is an inference, not a measured cache-miss count. Exact spare lanes do not reduce this footprint.

validation.components: All 3 variants pass direct scalar/AVX2 rank/below/ranks/route/select checks; n=0,1,31,32,33,63,64,65,127; sigma1..8; shifts0,3,30; rebuilding and sizeof32 checks. Every measured variant matches per-trial checksums.
validation.interval: Full existing test/unit/wavelet_matrix.cpp passes GCC15 for interval_one. Every measured current/candidate/old_quad checksum matches.
validation.additional_tests: No sanitizer runs were added for these rejected candidates.

component.checks: All scalar/AVX2 rank/below/route/select checks, sentinel boundaries, shift30, size32 and rebuilding passed.

interval.x_bounds: Uniform input values; only between swaps x/y unlike the main benchmark.
interval.checks: Candidate full existing unit passed GCC15; all baseline/candidate/old_quad checksums agree.

import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import random
import statistics
import subprocess

root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
folder=root/'.verify-helper/cache/wm_small_rank'
header=(folder/'source.hpp').read_text()
component=(folder/'component.hpp').read_text()
quad=(folder/'quad.hpp').read_text()
bench=(folder/'bench.cpp').read_text().replace('if (z.x > z.y) std::swap(z.x, z.y);','if (op == "between" && z.x > z.y) std::swap(z.x, z.y);')
fast=header
body='''
\t\tif (levels == 1) {
\t\t\tif (values.size() == 2) {
\t\t\t\tint a = bits[0].below(l, 1), b = bits[0].below(r, 1);
\t\t\t\tif (!x) return {a, b};
\t\t\t\treturn {middle[0][1] + l - a, middle[0][1] + r - b};
\t\t\t}
\t\t\treturn {middle[0][x] + bits[0].rank(l, x), middle[0][x] + bits[0].rank(r, x)};
\t\t}'''
for method in ['interval_scalar','interval_avx2']:
    signature=method+'(int l, int r, std::uint32_t x) const {'
    assert signature in fast
    fast=fast.replace(signature,signature+body)
variants={'current':(header,component),'interval_one':(fast,component),
          'old_quad':(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','523956f:data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp'],cwd=root,text=True),component)}
flags=['-std=c++23','-O2','-march=native','-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero','-DATCODER','-DONLINE_JUDGE']
with open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock','w') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    for name,(wm,octet) in variants.items():
        work=folder/('interval_'+name)
        (work/'data_structure').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        (work/'components').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (work/'data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp').write_text(wm)
        (work/'components/oct_bit_vector.hpp').write_text(octet)
        (work/'components/quad_bit_vector.hpp').write_text(quad)
        (work/'bench.cpp').write_text(bench)
        subprocess.run(['g++',*flags,'-I'+str(work),str(work/'bench.cpp'),'-o',str(work/'bench')],check=True)
    work=folder/'interval_interval_one'
    subprocess.run(['g++',*flags,'-I'+str(work),'-I'+str(root),str(root/'test/unit/wavelet_matrix.cpp'),'-o',str(work/'unit')],check=True)
    subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','2',str(work/'unit')],check=True)
    cases=[(n,m,'count') for n in (200000,500000) for m in (6,1,9,0)]+[(500000,0,o) for o in ('kth','freq')]
    rng=random.Random(20261019)
    raw={}
    for n,mode,op in cases:
        samples={v:[] for v in variants}
        checks=[]
        for trial in range(4):
            order=list(variants)
            rng.shuffle(order)
            checksum=None
            for name in order:
                result=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['taskset','-c','2',str(folder/('interval_'+name)/'bench'),str(n),'500000',str(mode),'0',op,'32',str(713+37*trial)],text=True))
                if checksum is None:checksum=result['checksum']
                assert checksum==result['checksum'],(name,n,mode,op)
                if trial:samples[name].append(result['ms'])
            checks.append(checksum)
        key=f'{n}/{mode}/{op}'
        raw[key]={'samples_ms':samples,'median_ms':{v:statistics.median(s) for v,s in samples.items()},'checksums':checks}
        print(key,raw[key]['median_ms'],flush=True)
        (folder/'interval_results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'flags':flags,'cpu':2,'trials':3,'warmups':1,'q':500000,'x_bounds':'Uniform input values; only between swaps x/y unlike the main benchmark.', 'header_sha256':{v:hashlib.sha256(w.encode()).hexdigest() for v,(w,c) in variants.items()}, 'component_sha256':hashlib.sha256(component.encode()).hexdigest(),'quad_sha256':hashlib.sha256(quad.encode()).hexdigest(),'bench_sha256':hashlib.sha256(bench.encode()).hexdigest(),'checks':'Candidate full existing unit passed GCC15; all baseline/candidate/old_quad checksums agree.','cases':raw},indent=2))
